headlines.text: On a Wednesday in 2020, back when there was a changing of the guard for the AEW Women's World Title as Nyla Rose vs. Riho battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.87 ? a good, competitive contest ? ending the champion's reign at 6 defenses. A "power versus speed" classic for the ages ? Riho survived a top-rope death valley driver to a stunned, roaring crowd before Rose finally sealed the title win with a spear and powerbomb, a landmark moment as the first transgender woman to become a world champion in a major U.S. wrestling promotion.

Turning the clock back to 2025: Castagnoli, PAC & Yuta vs. Undisputed Kingdom (Cole, O'Reilly & Strong) clashed for the AEW World Trios Titles, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.90. Undisputed Kingdom (Cole, O'Reilly & Strong) was challenging for gold for the very first time. A hard-fought battle for the gold.

Looking back to 2020, when Omega & Page vs. SCU (Kaz & Sky) fought tooth and nail for the AEW World Tag Team Titles, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.97 ? a solid showing. Every title match carries a little extra weight, and this one was no exception.
